notes: Decision maker: CTO (Mina Shah) — cautious, explicit BYOK requirement
Security lead quote: 'We cannot accept vendor-managed root keys; HSM-backed customer keys only.'
Primary constraint: data residency — transaction-level embeddings must remain in NA data centers
Encryption posture discussed repeatedly — customer expects:
- in-transit: mutual TLS between app and inference nodes, client certs from internal PKI
- at-rest: envelope encryption using customer-managed keys (CMEK), S3/GCS volumes encrypted
- key rotation: quarterly rotation for data keys; yearly rotation for master/KEK; rotation must be automated or have documented runbook
- KMS integration: prefer AWS KMS with HSM (CloudHSM) or on-prem HSM (Safenet) via KMIP; BYOK import required
- secrets management: HashiCorp Vault recommended; customer will not store secrets in plain text; need demo of Vault-to-runtime secret injection
SRE asks: cert lifecycle automation + Canary rollout that can invalidate certs gracefully
Legal: needs indemnity language for BYOK / HSM key compromise scenarios
Ops: wants event-level audit logs forwarded to Splunk/Datadog and stored 7 years (we proposed compressed archival)
Compliance: ISO27001 evidence requested for key handling and rotation; SOC2 controls mapping for Private deployment
Notes on performance: target p50 <= 120ms for 512-token re-ranking batch; cost sensitivity but will trade some unit cost for required controls
Integration notes: will require VPC peering + private control plane; VPN/Direct Connect acceptable; will test in staging first
POC success criteria (from customer): 1) mTLS end-to-end verified, 2) keys managed BYOK with rotation, 3) audit logs delivered to customer SIEM, 4) performance within SLA
encryption_posture_summary: Customer requires strong encryption posture: mutual TLS between app and inference nodes, envelope encryption at rest with customer-managed HSM-backed keys, automated key rotation cadence (quarterly for data keys), and Vault-based secret injection. Audit logs must be forwarded to their SIEM with 7-year retention; legal requires BYOK contract language and proof of HSM handling.
